ari2 = aris$ari/100

#prevalence
prev2=aris$prev/100000
#pop size
pop=1000000
#mortality
m=.005


res <- data.frame(ari=NA, dis.prev=NA, duration = NA, inf.prev=NA)

for(i in 1:dim(aris)[1]){
ari=ari2[i]
prev = prev2[i]
inf.new = pop*((1-prev)*(ari))
inf.1yr = inf.new*(1-.025)*(1-m)*(1-ari)
inf.2yr = inf.new*(1-.025)*(1-.01)*((1-m)^2)*((1-ari)^2)
inf.3yr = inf.new*(1-.025)*(1-.01)*(1-.005)*((1-m)^3)*((1-ari)^3)
inf.4yr = inf.new*(1-.025)*(1-.01)*((1-.005)^2)*((1-m)^4)*((1-ari)^4)
inf.5yr = inf.new*(1-.025)*(1-.01)*((1-.005)^3)*((1-m)^5)*((1-ari)^5)

#inf.dyr = pop*(1-prev)*(ari)*(1-.025)*(1-.01)*((1-.005)^4)*((1-0.00075)^d)*((1-m)^d)*((1-ari)^d)

#distribution of infection duration
inf.dur = data.frame(ari=NA, dis.prev=NA,duration=c(0:100), inf.prev=NA)
inf.dur[1:6,4] <- c(inf.new, inf.1yr, inf.2yr, inf.3yr, inf.4yr, inf.5yr )
for(d in 6:100){
inf.dur[d+1,4] <- pop*(1-prev)*(ari)*(1-.025)*(1-.01)*((1-.005)^4)*((1-0.00075)^(d-6))*((1-m)^d)*((1-ari)^d)
}
inf.dur$ari=ari
inf.dur$dis.prev=prev
res <- rbind(res, inf.dur) %>% na.omit()
}

#overall infection prevalence by ari and prev
inf.prev = res %>% group_by(ari, dis.prev) %>% summarise(inf.prev=sum(inf.prev))

inf.prev$uninfected <- 1000000 - inf.prev$inf.prev - (inf.prev$dis.prev*1000000)
inf.prev$new <- inf.prev$ari*inf.prev$uninfected
inf.prev$re <- inf.prev$ari*inf.prev$inf.prev
inf.prev$tot = inf.prev$re + inf.prev$new
inf.prev$tot/(inf.prev$inf.prev+ inf.prev$uninfected)
